rawContent: We will never forget Sandra Bland. Six years ago, her life was tragically cut short following a minor traffic violation. Incidents like this should never happen and Sandra Bland should still be alive. This year, she should have been able to celebrate turning 34. #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/1BcgjkgPXJ

The first use of the #BlackLivesMatter hashtag on Twitter occurred #OTD in 2013. 

Saddened by lack of justice for Trayvon Martin, @AliciaGarza posted "Black lives matter” on social media. Patrisse Cullors replied with #BlackLivesMatter, which would become a global rallying cry. https://t.co/Cn0Aze6FYS

Seven years ago, Michael Brown was tragically killed by Ferguson, MO Police Officer Darren Wilson. Michael Brown had his entire life ahead of him, and his killing is a reminder of how much work we have to do to reimagine public safety. #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/IeebOVv5D5
